evidence.evidence_text: We formalize a structural property of the causal (autoregressive) language modeling (CLM) objective: reversal invariance.
We formalize a structural property of the causal (autoregressive) language modeling (CLM) objective: reversal invariance.
Formally, the next-token prediction loss assigns identical likelihood to a corpus and its reversal, implying that standard CLM pretraining is direction-blind.
